Spacious & Bright | Brand New 2 Bedroom Apartment | Binghatti Onyx, JVC
Step into comfort, modernity, and elegance with this brand new 2 bedroom apartment in the iconic Binghatti Onyx, located in the highly sought after community of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC).

The open-plan living and dining area features large windows that fill the space with natural light, while the sleek, well-appointed kitchen complements modern urban living. Both bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes, and the two bathrooms feature high-quality fixtures and thoughtful layouts.

Residents of Binghatti Onyx enjoy a full suite of lifestyle amenities, paired with the convenience of a central location in District 15, Jumeirah Village Circle.

Bedrooms: 2 spacious bedrooms with skyline views
Bathrooms: 2 modern, well finished bathrooms
